tool_description: Retrieve current weather and multi-day forecasts for any city worldwide.

api_list.name: get_current_weather
api_list.description: Fetches real-time weather data for a specified location, providing immediate conditions like current temperature, feels like sensation, wind, and humidity.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The name of the city to query (e.g., 'Paris', 'New York').

api_list.name: get_weather_forecast
api_list.description: Provides a multi-day weather forecast for a specific location. It includes daily high/low temperatures, the chance of rain, maximum wind speed, and general weather conditions (e.g., 'Sunny', 'Partly Cloudy').

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The name of the city to query (e.g., 'Paris', 'New York').

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The number of days for the forecast. Default is 3.
